title: Najuch and Sun 2019 suspension rheology simulation data
license_basis: Explicit dc.rights field of the official University of Edinburgh dataset metadata. The repository license.txt is a depositor agreement, not the CC license text.
reference_scope: Published independent LBM-DEM simulations of identical spheres under simple shear at Re=0.1 and five volume fractions 0.05 through 0.25. Not laboratory measurements.
method_selection: SP is the reference branch because the primary dataset description identifies its stresslet consistency. BB is retained for comparison; it is not silently combined or selected by fit error.
modifications: Original numeric members retained without alteration; renamed files and added this attribution/provenance object. No figures, plotting scripts, copied paper text or third-party digitized curves included.
acceptance_budget: 5 percent relative viscosity screening budget fixed before the first implementation run; not an uncertainty estimate or a claim to other suspensions.
